government_types.name: Presidential republic
government_types.description: A directly elected president is both head of state and head of government; the legislature is separately elected.

government_types.name: Parliamentary republic
government_types.description: The government depends on the confidence of parliament; a largely ceremonial president is head of state.

government_types.name: Semi-presidential republic
government_types.description: An elected president shares executive power with a prime minister responsible to parliament.

government_types.name: Directorial republic
government_types.description: A collegial executive council elected by parliament collectively serves as head of state and government.

government_types.name: Constitutional monarchy
government_types.description: A hereditary monarch is head of state with limited powers; government depends on parliament.

government_types.name: Absolute monarchy
government_types.description: A hereditary monarch holds executive and legislative authority; any assembly is advisory or limited.

government_types.name: Theocratic republic
government_types.description: Religious authorities hold final power over elected institutions.

government_types.name: One-party state
government_types.description: A single ruling party controls the state; leadership changes through party institutions.

government_types.name: Military government
government_types.description: The armed forces govern directly, usually after a coup, with constitutional institutions suspended.

government_types.name: Competitive authoritarian
government_types.description: Elections and opposition exist, but the incumbent controls the state, media and courts enough to tilt competition.

government_types.name: Personalist regime
government_types.description: Power rests with an individual ruler outside, or above, formal institutions.

government_types.name: Failed or contested state
government_types.description: No government controls the whole territory, or rival authorities claim to govern.

government_types.name: International transitional administration
government_types.description: Territory administered by an international mission pending a political settlement.

government_types.name: Insurgent movement
government_types.description: An armed movement controlling territory and claiming to govern it.
